notes.title: An issue where adjusting camera control settings would overwrite other params
notes.content: Fixed a bug where changing camera control settings in the Options menu would inadvertently reset Quality, Field of View, and motion blur to 0.

notes.title: Adjusted lighting so the game remains fully playable even when Quality is set
notes.content:
* Adjusted lighting so the game remains fully playable even when Quality is set to 0–1 in the options.
* Fixed a bug where, after completing the ending, restarting the game would resume from just before the ending.

notes.title: Fix for Screen Flicker and Progression-Blocking After Stage Transitions, and Pre
notes.content:
We’ve fixed a bug that allowed the field of view (FOV) to be set to 0 via the Options menu.

We also addressed an issue where, if your FOV was already set to 0 (the minimum value) in the previous version and you moved to a new stage, the screen would flicker and go completely black, making further progress impossible.

In earlier versions, if the FOV=0 setting was saved, it would persist even after restarting the game, resulting in an unplayable state. In this update, we’ve ensured that the minimum FOV can no longer be set to 0, so players who encountered this issue should now be able to continue normally.

We sincerely apologize to any players who were affected by this problem. We remain committed to improving the gameplay experience and appreciate your continued support.

notes.title: v1.3 Update: New Options to Reduce Motion Sickness and Improve Performance
notes.content: [p]In the v1.3 update, we’ve added the following settings:[/p][list][*][p][b]Field of View[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Motion Blur[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Render Quality[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you experience motion sickness, try widening your Field of View and setting both Camera Shake and Motion Blur to 0 to help alleviate symptoms.[/p][p]If performance feels sluggish on your machine, lower the Render Quality to [b]2[/b]. You can also set it to [b]0–1[/b], but doing so will significantly reduce lighting and visual fidelity and may make some sections difficult to navigate.[/p][p]For anyone who discontinued playing due to motion sickness or hardware limitations, we hope these new options will help you enjoy Kind() Station once more. If you still find the game unplayable, refunds are of course available—please follow the standard Steam refund process.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of Kind() Station![/p][p]Studio 非[/p]

notes.title: v1.3 Update: New Options to Reduce Motion Sickness and Improve Performance
notes.content:
**Expanded Options Features:**

* Field of View
* Motion Blur
* Render Quality

Other improvements include difficulty adjustments and performance optimizations.

notes.title: Upcoming Update: Motion‐Sickness Mitigation & Performance Optimizations
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing Kind() Station.[/p][p]While we’re honored by all the positive feedback, we’ve also received reports of motion‐sickness in some sections and performance slowdowns in parts of certain stages. We’re actively exploring solutions to address these issues.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize to anyone who was unable to continue playing because of these problems. If you can bear with us a little longer, we would be grateful if you’d give the game another try after our next update. We’ll share full details of the fixes as soon as they’re ready.[/p][p]Please understand that, due to system limitations, we may not be able to eliminate every issue completely—but we remain committed to delivering the best possible experience. Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]Studio非[/p]

notes.title: v1.2: Bug fixes, performance improvements, and more.
notes.content:
* Fixed missing collision areas where the player could fall through
* Improved overall performance
* Fixed a bug that reset option settings after clearing the game
* Made minor adjustments to stages
* And other small improvements

notes.title: Fixed bugs including low text readability, missing collisions
notes.content:
- Addressed an issue where certain signboards were excessively bright, making their text small and difficult to read.
- Fixed a problem where missing collision on restroom areas caused the player to fall through.
Corrected a bug that prevented the reset function from working properly.
- Fixed a progression-blocking issue that occurred when attempting to continue from the title screen after clearing the game.
- Implemented various minor presentation improvements.

Thank you for your continued support of Kind() Station!

notes.title: Regarding the bug in which certain wayfinding signs become excessively bright.
notes.content: [p]We’re currently aware of an issue where certain wayfinding signs become excessively bright. Since this impacts game progression and difficulty, we’re working on a fix. We apologize for the inconvenience and will provide an update as soon as possible. Thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Issue with Game Reset Feature
notes.content: [p]There is a known issue where the “hold ESC twice” reset function does not properly clear save data.[/p][p]We are working on a fix, but in the meantime you can manually reset your progress by deleting the .sav files located at:[/p][p][/p][p]C:\\Users\\<YourUserName>\\AppData\\Local\\KindStation\\Saved\\SaveGames\\[/p][p][/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.[/p][p]Thank you for playing Kind() Station![/p][p]Studio 非[/p]
